Consider the curver(t)=(1+2sin⁡(2t))i+(2−2cos⁡(2t))j, t≥0, for which the arc length s from r(0) to r(t) is given by s=4t. Find R(s), the parametrization of the curve by its arc length s.

a
 R(s)=(1+2sin⁡(8s))i+(2−2cos⁡(8s))j
b
 R(s)=(1+2sin⁡(2s))i+(2−2cos⁡(2s))j
c
 R(s)=(1+2sin⁡(s2))i+(2+2cos⁡(s2))j
d
 R(s)=(1+2sin⁡(s2))i+(2−2cos⁡(s2))j
e
 R(s)=(1+2sin⁡(s4))i+(2−2cos⁡(s4))j
